summary: Frontend only. Admin login (admin@fieledeus.com) -> /admin loads with 7 tabs (overview, users, associations, appointments, posts, housing, ads), each opens without page errors. admin-church-dashboard-link exists (href /igreja/#/dashboard, target _blank, text 'Abrir painel do site da Igreja'); clicking it opens a new tab that shows the church DashboardLayout with nav Home/Assistant/Membros/Aluno/Kids. Every nav link routes correctly (/dashboard/assistant, /membros, /aluno, /kids with the nested Kids Dashboard, Home), and all are placeholder pages as expected. No blank page, no JS errors. /church iframe renders after the rebuild: the menu includes ESTUDO and clicking CÉLULAS scrolls the page (scrollY 1208). The church JS chunk starts with the /* eslint-disable */ banner.

issues: Placeholder-only pages ('UI placeholder.'). Expected per the original repo, but the user may expect real content.

critical_code_review_comments: The church /igreja/#/dashboard can be opened directly without authentication (ProtectedRoute/ProtectedTeamRoute are placeholders). Anyone with the URL can open it. That is acceptable only while the pages hold no real data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App login is at /auth (not /login), with testids email-input, password-input and submit-button. The /church page embeds /igreja/ in an iframe. The church dashboard uses a HashRouter at /igreja/#/dashboard/*.
